items.title: Deafheaven Ready New EP That’s “By Far The Heaviest Thing” They’ve Ever Done
items.summary: Last year, Deafheaven released their album Lonely People With Power . It was heavy , and it was also great. In the many years since they first came to internet prominence, Deafheaven have had a complicated relationship with the extreme metal underground that birthed then, and they seem to be fully embracing intensity right now. In fact, they apparently have a new EP in the works, and guitarist Kerry McCoy identifies it as "the heaviest thing" they've ever done. items.title: Walt Dickerson :: To My Queen
items.summary: An unsung pioneer of the jazz vibraphone, the elusive Philadelphia-born musician Walt Dickerson is best known for his collaborative seventies album Visions with Sun Ra. With a dynamite quartet featuring a young Andrew Hill on piano and drummer Andrew Cyrille, 1962's career highlight To My Queen is a tender, lovingly crafted suite showcasing the vibraphonist's asymmetrical and self-proclaimed plush metallic tones.
